The `exponential_saturation` term represents the benefit of increased electrolyte availability, while the `attenuation` term (`-p0*h`) represents the limitation from oxygen transport (A33_P4). The sum of these log-responses (product in linear space) creates a peak (A10_P3). This is a rival to the already-tested composition `saturation` + `attenuation` and to the single-template peak models.
